prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph shot on 35 mm colour negative film at night in heavy London rain, camera at standing head height on the wet kerb about two metres from a red double-decker bus that has stopped at a junction, lens almost square-on to its flank so the front drop of the bus's T-shaped side advert fills the upper two thirds of the frame. Visible film grain, slight halation round the lamps, shallow depth of field with the slogan crisp. The slogan is the only readable text in the frame: no route number, no destination, no plates, no other signs. Thanks.
